product_metadata.title: MM TJ Products Artificial Golden Roses- Everlasting Golden Roses Bouquet- 7 Stems Bouquet of Golden Roses
features: WHAT YOU NEED: Are you looking for original ideas to give your house a fresh look? Tired of walking into the same dull living room where nothing stands out? We have the solution!

TDECORATIVE ARRANGEMENTS: These everlasting golden roses are ideal centrepieces for some DYI special arrangements or crafts that will guarantee to amaze your guests. You can easily incorporate them with other types of flowers or turn them into a real work of art on their own.

WEDDING AND PARTY DECORATIONS: These 7 stems bouquets will work as a charm as table decorations on your special wedding day, no matter the selected location. They are great for garden parties and events, giving a bright and colourful air.

FLEXIBLE STEMS: This unique decorative bouquet contains 7 golden stems and has a total length of 13 inches (flower and stem). Each stem has a special flexible wire design incorporated, allowing you to bend and arrange your bouquet as you like without fear of tearing it.

ECONOMICAL: If you’re a flower passionate, then you surely know how expensive a real bouquet can be, and how little it lasts. This everlasting golden bouquet is an economical and practical alternative, allowing you to save both money and time.
description: When it comes to our customers’ satisfaction, we have one rule: settle for nothing but the best. That’s why we work only with premium quality products and manufacturers, that are guaranteed to deliver to our high expectations.
Why is this product for you?

Because decorating can be no easy task when you’ve run out of fresh ideas and are tired of seeing the same old clichés they show in magazines. Your original taste will be successfully represented by these unconventional golden roses, whether you choose to use them in a decorative arrangement or by their own.
Some of the great features of this bouquet:
Intense colour that doesn’t fade with time;
Can be used outside, for decorations or crafts;
Flexible wired stems that can be shaped to suit your needs.
